title: How CBP and ICE Obligated OBBA Funds in Calendar Year 2025
footer_text:
Notes: Only categories with at least $100 million in calendar-year 2025 OBBA obligations are shown; smaller categories are omitted.
Calendar-year 2025 totals are derived from cumulative quarter-end File B snapshots by differencing Mar. 31, Jun. 30, and Sep. 30 against the
prior quarter and then adding Dec. 31, 2025. Source: USAspending.gov File B.
